inventory_method: Independent streaming read of both exact emitted IR files: SHA256/bytes, definition/export counts, opcode and predicate counts, every external target count and total calls. No compiler/pipeline/workload executed for this review.
binding: Producer verifies each raw SHA before any rewrite. Each pass independently rereads the pinned original, checks SHA/bytes, parses it in a separate LLVM context and compares complete canonical module-print SHA fingerprints after normalizing only ModuleID. Source/triple/layout, opcodes/predicates, all external declarations/calls, total calls, definitions and private-name collisions are checked before mutation. There is no force/trust switch or generic module mode.

cast_proof.original_shape: Each source vector is insertelement(poison, initialized scalar i32 coefficient load, lane0). Lanes1..7 are poison. Each vector sitofp has exactly one use: an existing all-lane0 FP shuffle.
cast_proof.index_proof: Uniform induction variable starts0, increments1 and exits at25. cn/cd use iv+1 only when iv<6, so indices1..6; en/ed use iv-18 only when iv>=20, so indices2..6. Every table is initialized internal constant[7xi32].
cast_proof.exactness: Every magnitude <=339200<2^24; signed i32-to-f32 conversion is exact, including signs, under all rounding modes and introduces no conversion exception.
cast_proof.rewrite: At the original cast location, constrained sitofp.f32.i32 consumes the existing scalar load with round.dynamic/fpexcept.strict. Insert the FP result at lane0 of an otherwise-poison v8f32, replace only the old cast value and retain the original shuffle. No integer freeze, pointer/index/mask rewrite, scalar-load change or other-lane evaluation.
cast_proof.closed_checks: Require exact cast/source/destination types, poison insertion at lane0, initialized immutable seven-element integer table, each coefficient within exact float32 integer range, one cast per table, sole original zero-index shuffle use, and the full original module fingerprint.

endpoint.added_arithmetic_proof: The sole fmul, IR line3931, is denominatorScale v8f32 multiplied by splat(float bits0x29800000), exactly2^-44. Require this constant at every lane; convert to constrained FMul with unchanged v8f32 precision/order, round.dynamic/fpexcept.strict and FP-only operand freeze. Retain subsequent bitcast/integer word+1 and all original zero/bounds/refusal branches.
endpoint.added_comparison_proof: Three olt sites at4029/4042/4243 implement source RPScalarLess(a,b). They require constrained fcmps with predicate olt and fpexcept.strict, matching LLVM23's signaling x86 ordering predicate. No comparison predicate or mask changes.
endpoint.header_domain: Original shared Endpoint admission and specialized header selection/refusal remain exact, including the permitted program word11241 and all other canonical program words. New hidden routing must inherit the same genuine preflight authority.

shared_conversion.types: All original add/sub/mul/comparison operands are eight-lane float32. Preserve result types, primitive order and predicates. Scalarization applies only to the four proven coefficient casts and reinserts the same vector result shape.
shared_conversion.strict: round.dynamic where applicable, fpexcept.strict, strictfp on copied definitions and every call; no FMA, fast flags or forced inlining.
shared_conversion.memory_effects: Union inaccessible-memory read/write into copied definitions and nonintrinsic calls; preserve accessible-memory/alias facts. Unchanged exception-free representation/integer/memory intrinsics retain their exact effects.
shared_conversion.representation: Original fneg/fabs and every integer operation, pointer, index, CFG edge, memory mask and load/store remain unchanged. FP-only freezes are inserted for copied FP arithmetic/comparison operands and original opaque-fmaxf scalar arguments.
shared_conversion.names: Rename both ordinary exports and masked clones to the stated sirius_scope_* names; rename only the nine actual sirius_native_v4_* math references to sirius_scope_v4_*. All become hidden/dso_local. Existing internal linkage stays internal. Opaque sirius_simd_fmaxf remains unchanged.
shared_conversion.external_closure: Only the exact counted math references, existing opaque fmaxf and listed LLVM intrinsics are admitted. tagged_sqrt8 already exists in the private math copy. Added memset64 and Endpoint float32 masked-store are memory operations, not numerical callbacks or FP observers.

source_semantic_scope_proof: This is a reviewed source/LLVM refinement argument for the two exact pinned modules, NOT a machine-checked whole-program lane analysis or a waiver for arbitrary IR.

Both ordinary and masked export forms zero their complete context before ComputeOwnedRow. Original admission proves every scheduled owned active row reaches the full staged-output clear before subsequent arithmetic/metadata refusal.

Ordinary export active mask is programIndex<groups; masked clone intersects that predicate with the existing incoming<8xi1> __mask. Original varying masks, ordered writes, alias snapshots, full physical A/B initialization and masked copyback remain exact.

Initialized uint32 input bits, including NaNs and handled-invalid encodings, are defined values. Elementwise FP freeze preserves every defined bit. It refines excluded undef/poison choices and does not fabricate an active input; no blanket claim that poison arithmetic immediately causes UB is used.
New hidden entries may execute only inside genuine admitted synchronous Vulkan jobs, retaining original pointer/extents/disjointness/per-row guards, tails and OS-aware ISA selection.

cs_exec_fn saves/restores the full same-thread MXCSR. util_fpstate_set_ieee32 sets(saved|0x1f80)&~0xe040: every trap masked, RNE, DAZ/FTZ off. No FP-status/control observer exists in the closed numerical code; unchanged fmaxf neither reads MXCSR status nor writes errno. Excluded-lane exception differences are contained until full restoration.

Required postconditions remain identical complete visible output/input/sentinel behavior, routing/refusal, errno and restored caller MXCSR. Old public raw/scalar/math objects and direct public math sticky-flag contracts remain exact. No cache/layout/allocation/count/governor or Vulkan-route changes are authorized by these passes.
qualification_limits: Source only. No remaining-stage plugin compile/load, conversion, LLVM verifier execution, link, numerical/flag fixture, PC observation, timing or provider adoption performed. Producer, SDK/plugin linkage and all subsequent execution remain root-owned.
